investigations.summary: PSMDB Replica 6.x/7.x/8.x on clients 3.8.0-3.10.0 (15 lanes) failed the same 8 update tests as nights 115 and 116 ('pmm-admin: error: unexpected argument update'), and help tests failed PMM-T2751-T2753 with 'Unexpected end of JSON input' again. Both are fixed by pmm-qa#1815, which merged after this night started (the run used main 7271e147). No new cause.

Generic (ps,ENCRYPTED_CLIENT_CONFIG=true, pmm3-rc package): pmm-framework gave up on pmm-agent setup on ps_pmm_8_4_1, the same step as night 115: the open PMM-15968 (setup with --config-file-key-file fails after the package wrote a plain-text pmm-agent.yaml). The job log truncates the agent output. Recurrence added to the ticket.
